messages:
tay-sales: Quick thread: Prospect (NordLedger) wants strict EU residency for a POC. They require data-at-rest+in-transit in eu-central-1 only, control plane also EU, and BYOK using customer HSM. Also want list of subprocessors and confirmation that no telemetry leaves EU. Can presales/ops/sec confirm feasibility and costs?

nina-presales: We can support with Dedicated or Private. Hosted cannot support customer HSM. Need to clarify: do they want multi-AZ within eu-central-1 or absolutely single AZ? That affects HA and pricing.

omar-ops: Technical: tenant pinning to eu-central-1 ok. We can disable cross-region failover. KV cache must be local-only to avoid cross-region cache reads. Example policy snippet I use in deployments: 
```yaml
tenant_pin: true
allowed_regions: [eu-central-1]
fallback: none
kv_cache: local_only
```
Note this increases cold-start latency and reduces global throughput optimization.

rachel-sec: Security: BYOK via customer CloudHSM requires Private control plane or on-prem package. We'll need an HSM keywrap flow and KMS access agreement. Telemetry: we can configure to keep logs in EU and exclude user payloads from telemetry, but we need legal to sign subproc attestation. I'll attach SOC2 report and current subproc list to the ticket.

nina-presales: Pricing impact (estimates): Dedicated EU-only pool -> +20% baseline; BYOK integration -> $2.5k one-time + $800/mo for key ops and attestation. Single-AZ HA constraints may lower HA SLO or require standby capacity. Final numbers after QPS + token estimate.

infra-bot: Ticket INF-9898 created: "NordLedger EU-only POC: BYOK, subproc list, region-pin" assigned to nina-presales, omar-ops, rachel-sec.

tay-sales: Thanks. I'll ask the customer to confirm single-AZ vs multi-AZ and share network diagrams + HSM contact. Can we schedule a 45min tech call Thu 14:00 CET?

nina-presales: Works for me. I'll draft the EU-Dedicated + HSM addendum to share beforehand.

omar-ops: I'll prep peering checklist and short ops runbook for tenant pinning and kv cache settings.

rachel-sec: I'll prepare subproc attestation docs and list of telemetry flags we can toggle.

tay-sales: Great, assigning actions: nina -> proposal; rachel -> security docs; omar -> ops runbook. I'll confirm call with NordLedger. :thumbsup:
